description.zh: 点播打包配置名称，长度128个字符，格式：[A-Za-z0-9_-]+，用户维度唯一。
description.en: The name of the packaging configuration. The name must be unique in an account and can be up to 128 characters in length. Letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-) are supported.
The description of the packaging configuration.

description.zh: 点播打包组名称，长度128个字符，格式：[A-Za-z0-9_-]+。
description.en: The name of the packaging group. The name can be up to 128 characters in length. Letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-) are supported.

description.zh:
点播打包类型，支持：
- HLS: HLC协议播放格式；
- HLS_CMAF： HLS协议的CMAF播放格式；
- DASH: DASH协议播放格式。
description.en:
The package type.

- HLS: packages content into TS segments for delivery over the HLS protocol.

- HLS\_CMAF: packages content into CMAF segments for delivery over the HLS protocol.

- DASH: packages content for delivery over the DASH protocol.
